page.overview:
Who is Chamaru?

At some point in time, Chamaru lost his right hind leg during a mission which Katasuke Tōno replaced with a prosthetic, leading his partner, Akita, to join the village's Scientific Ninja Weapons Team.

According to Akita, Chamaru is a very dutiful dog and became saddened when his lost leg robbed him of the ability to continue being a ninken. Chamaru is also well-acquainted with Boruto Uzumaki.

Chamaru greatly resembles the Shiba Inu breed of dogs. He is a medium-sized, light brown canine with a very bushy tail. His right hind leg has been replaced with a prosthetic one.

His partner Akita has been credited with being well versed in her clan's techniques including the Fang Passing Fang, and techniques. As her canine companion, Chamaru is undoubtedly also able to perform these collaborative techniques.
